cases.query:
How does Kubernetes handle a failed application pod in a Deployment?
Scope: Cover both a container crash/restart inside the existing Pod and the Pod being deleted/replaced; explain the distinction.

source_evidence.text: Only a .spec.template.spec.restartPolicy equal to Always is allowed
If you manually delete a Pod, the lifecycle is controlled by the ReplicaSet and the replacement will be created immediately

cases.scope_note: User chose both behaviors with distinction. Do not equate a container crash with automatic creation of a new Pod; no undocumented kubelet/backoff details required.
